name: Grey rock hide
label: Hides
lead: Layered hide styled as grey rock with terraced slabs - shelter underneath, plus steps for climbing and basking on top.

description.html: This hide is shaped like a rock made of stacked slabs that descend in terraces, like steps. The color is grey with slightly bluish and greenish highlights, similar to slate. At the front there is a wide arched entrance into the cavity under the rock.

Your animal can hide and rest underneath, while the upper layers serve as a place to climb and bask. A lizard can climb the terraces slowly to the top, so the hide also adds surface for your animal to move on. It suits lizards, snakes and spiders.
The cool grey tones blend well with darker substrates, grey rocks and rock-look 3D backgrounds.

If you place the hide under a heat lamp, the highest terrace becomes a basking spot; check with a thermometer that the surface does not get too hot. Set it directly on the floor so it does not wobble when your animal climbs, and add a second hide on the cool side. Clean the layers with a small brush under warm water from time to time.
